numerator_definition: Pregnant women who completed 4 or more antenatal visits
denominator_definition: Expected pregnancies in the catchment area for the month
why_it_matters: Four visits is the minimum for a woman to be screened, treated and counselled before delivery.

numerator_definition: Deliveries attended by a doctor, nurse or midwife
denominator_definition: All deliveries reported by the facility
why_it_matters: A trained hand at delivery is the single biggest protector against maternal death.

numerator_definition: Deliveries that happened inside a health facility
denominator_definition: Expected deliveries in the catchment area for the month
why_it_matters: Shows whether women are reaching the facility at all, not just who attended them.

numerator_definition: Infants who completed the full routine immunisation schedule
denominator_definition: Expected infants (surviving infants) in the catchment for the month
why_it_matters: A child who finishes the schedule is protected; a child who starts and stops is not.

numerator_definition: Infants who started immunisation minus infants who completed it
why_it_matters: Dropout is the honest test of follow-up: it counts the children the system lost midway.
